description: Fictional teaching documents, not AMU policies.
question: J'ai perdu ma carte étudiante. Comment la remplacer ?

documents.title: Card activation
documents.text: Activate a new student card through the student portal.

documents.title: Lost student card
documents.text: If you lose your student card, request a replacement at the student office.

documents.title: Collecting a replacement card
documents.text: Collect the replacement card at the student office and bring photo ID.

documents.title: Library loans
documents.text: Renew a library loan through your library account.

documents.title: Campus Wi-Fi
documents.text: Connect to the campus Wi-Fi using your university login.

documents.title: Course timetable
documents.text: Find lecture times and rooms in the timetable portal.
